name: Midou Kazumi
source:
A teacher at Kamuro high school and the niece of the school's director. She has a high-spirited personality and is a confident person.

She is single and popular among the students, but is a true lesbian. Basically, she looks down on men and thinks women are to be loved.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080131193829/http://www.finish-game.com/games/cheergirl/cha3_chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
